integrity: A self-contained proof and standalone finite checker are included. Finite tests do not certify the infinite family. Source publication date is independently verifiable; no authorship or independent scientific review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty rooted tree orders with Alexandrov upset topology, continuous self-maps, and arbitrary one-atom valuations. The theorem bounds exact eventual periods of global next-iteration truth sets, not arbitrary posets, independent-model axiomatizability, or the periods of general dynamic-topological formulas. Classical Landau theory is not claimed new. Equivalence to earlier finite-poset transformation literature is a residual risk.
title: Leaf-budget spectrum of temporal periods on finite Alexandrov trees
